heading: Tuesday, December 2, 2025
topLine: Mistral releases Mistral 3 family, including Mistral Large 3.

items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral 3 family, including Mistral Large 3
items.summary: Mistral Large 3 is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 41B active and 675B total parameters and image understanding, released alongside dense Ministral 3 models at 3B, 8B and 14B, each with base, instruct and reasoning variants. All are open-weight under Apache 2.0; Mistral reports Large 3 ranked second among open non-reasoning models on LMArena's text leaderboard.
